-- Identify potential outliers using 3 standard deviations
-- Lower bound: mean - 3*std
-- Upper bound: mean + 3*std

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(cognitive_score) as min_score,
    MAX(cognitive_score) as max_score,
    MIN(reaction_ms) as min_reaction,
    MAX(reaction_ms) as max_reaction
  FROM measurements
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_score = 74.03703703703704,
    std_score = 25.19476941818807,
    avg_reaction = 413.5925925925926,
    std_reaction = 283.3963667478309
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_score,
      sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) as std_score,
      AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction,
      sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) as std_reaction
    FROM measurements
  )
)
SELECT 
  id,
  session_id,
  participant_id,
  condition,
  cognitive_score,
  reaction_ms,
  case 
    when cognitive_score < (74.03703703703704 - 3 * 25.19476941818807) 
      or cognitive_score > (74.03703703703704 + 3 * 25.19476941818807)
      or reaction_ms < (413.5925925925926 - 3 * 283.3963667478309)
      or reaction_ms > (413.5925925925926 + 3 * 283.3963667478309)
    then 'OUTLIER'
    else 'NORMAL'
  end as data_quality_flag
FROM measurements;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_score,
    sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) as std_score,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction,
    sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) as std_reaction
  FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
  session_id,
  participant_id,
  condition,
  cognitive_score,
  reaction_ms,
  status,
  recorded_at,
  ABS(cognitive_score - (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)) / (SELECT sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) FROM measurements) as z_score_score,
  ABS(reaction_ms - (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) / (SELECT sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) FROM measurements) as z_score_reaction
FROM measurements
ORDER BY z_score_score DESC, z_score_reaction DESC;

-- Check status values to understand what records should be excluded
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM measurements;

-- Create cleaned_measurements table excluding anomalous outliers
-- Using statistical approach: exclude records with z-scores > 2.5 (>2.5 standard deviations from mean)
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
  session_id,
  participant_id,
  condition,
  cognitive_score,
  reaction_ms,
  recorded_at,
  status,
  notes,
  -- Calculate z-scores for reference
  ABS(cognitive_score - (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)) / 
    (SELECT sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) FROM measurements) as cognitive_zscore,
  ABS(reaction_ms - (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) / 
    (SELECT sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) FROM measurements) as reaction_zscore
FROM measurements
WHERE 
  -- Outliers identified as those with cognitive_score z-score > 2.5 or reaction_ms z-score > 2.5
  ABS(cognitive_score - (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)) / 
    (SELECT sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) FROM measurements) <= 2.5
  AND 
  ABS(reaction_ms - (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) / 
    (SELECT sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) FROM measurements) <= 2.5
ORDER BY recorded_at;

-- Create with pre-calculated statistics
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements (
  session_id TEXT,
  participant_id TEXT,
  condition TEXT,
  cognitive_score REAL,
  reaction_ms REAL,
  recorded_at TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  notes TEXT
);

INSERT INTO cleaned_measurements
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_score,
    sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) as std_score,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction,
    sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) as std_reaction
  FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
  m.session_id,
  m.participant_id,
  m.condition,
  m.cognitive_score,
  m.reaction_ms,
  m.recorded_at,
  m.status,
  m.notes
FROM measurements m, stats
WHERE ABS(m.cognitive_score - stats.avg_score) / stats.std_score <= 2.5
  AND ABS(m.reaction_ms - stats.avg_reaction) / stats.std_reaction <= 2.5
ORDER BY m.recorded_at;
SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count FROM cleaned_measurements;

-- Show the excluded records (outliers)
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_score,
    sqrt(AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score)) as std_score,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction,
    sqrt(AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms)) as std_reaction
  FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
  m.session_id,
  m.participant_id,
  m.condition,
  m.cognitive_score,
  m.reaction_ms,
  m.status,
  m.recorded_at,
  ABS(m.cognitive_score - stats.avg_score) / stats.std_score as cognitive_zscore,
  ABS(m.reaction_ms - stats.avg_reaction) / stats.std_reaction as reaction_zscore,
  'EXCLUDED' as reason
FROM measurements m, stats
WHERE ABS(m.cognitive_score - stats.avg_score) / stats.std_score > 2.5
   OR ABS(m.reaction_ms - stats.avg_reaction) / stats.std_reaction > 2.5;
